reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper with a holidays parameter, but app.ts re-writes the weekend-or-holiday predicate inline instead of using the new isNonWorkingDay, which is kept private.

duplication.why: The 'isWeekend || holidays.includes(day)' test is written three times (private helper in shared/schedules.ts plus two inline copies in server/schedules/app.ts), and the daily-skip branch is now repeated in getUpcomingDates as well as getDatesInRange and getNextDate.

placement.why: The core adjustment correctly lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the non-working-day rule leaks into server/schedules/app.ts and getNextDate reaches into dateCond.value.holidays with a fallback instead of carrying holidays through the parsed schedule data uniformly.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but it reformats untouched conditions in getNextDate and changes getUpcomingDates' daily behaviour (now skipping weekend days) beyond the holiday feature.

maintainability.why: The holiday rule has several independent definitions and the budget schedule-template callers of getDateWithSkippedWeekend were not given holidays, so the rule already disagrees across paths.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange inline 'd.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))' instead of a shared non-working-day predicate; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of the non-working-day predicate in app.ts are plain inline repetitions, not reshaped.

one_place.where: Rule defined in private isNonWorkingDay (shared/schedules.ts) plus two inline copies in server/schedules/app.ts; server/budget/schedule-template.ts getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls ignore holidays.
